title: Bounces in a fall
description: Level 1 downswings in a fall from 67,158. The first bounce, from 65,906 (13 Apr 01:00), went 142% of the way back, beyond the bounce high before it: a bullish market structure break, and the retracement reads past 100%. The next, from 61,982 (13 Apr 20:00), came 82% of the way back to 66,669 over a day and a half, without closing above 67,687; that deep bounce then broke its own structure and a range was identified, which this example leaves to the Range term. The bounce from 61,791 read 47%.
